head: 226eb498b712c75e815f901bf6352d69be0f9169
summary: Independent review validated both merged-PR findings. The localhost name-to-listen gap is real; canonicalizing localhost to numeric 127.0.0.1 before ListenAndServe is the smallest robust fix. Rollback suppression is a real integrity defect; propagated errors, RolledBack=false on incomplete recovery, and an injected rollback-failure regression test satisfy the contract. Targeted tests passed.
